first_win_baseline.principle: the last-submission baseline first-win (0.04) -- the apples-to-apples comparison the readiness gate uses.

first_win_ci_lower.principle: bootstrap-CI lower bound > baseline is the falsifiable improvement criterion; a point estimate alone is gameable by a single lucky variant.

first_win_rate_integrated.principle: the held-out generic first-win on color-permuted variants is the only offline proxy that tracks the scored leaderboard lane; the replay count does not.

inference_substrate.principle: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- the held-out proxy runs the scored agent over cached color-permuted variants offline, no live game server (1s floor).

multi_level_deepen_rate_integrated.principle: deepening past L1 is the second scored lever; tracking it held-out keeps A4 honest about depth without using the replay count.

null_delta_methodology_note.principle: present when first_win delta is ~0 -- a non-empty note why a flat first-win is an honest no-leaderboard-change (the marker the TAUTOLOGY carve-out reads; the exp4691 flat null was quarantined for omitting it).

parity_test_green.principle: the held-out proxy is only valid if the measured agent is byte-for-byte the SUBMITTED_AGENT_CONFIG; a parity miss invalidates any readiness claim.

positive_control_passed.principle: bool(parity_test_green AND no_regression_vs_baseline) -- GATES the null-delta exemption so an UNVALIDATED flat null (parity failed / regression) is NOT excused (a fabricator cannot dodge by merely claiming no change).

preconditions_checked.principle: records resources verified (SUBMITTED_AGENT_CONFIG importable, experiment_4605 importable); pre-empts missing-resource fabrication.

ready_for_operator_submit.principle: True if parity green AND the held-out first-win readiness gate passes; the task NEVER submits (operator-only).

replay_count_is_not_the_score.principle: MUST be true -- explicitly records that live_submittable_level_count is NOT the leaderboard score (the retired dead-end framing).

replay_package_floor_reproduced.principle: the replay package stays a reproduced FLOOR artifact, but its level count is explicitly NOT the leaderboard score (the retargeted framing).

reproducibility_checksum.principle: content-addressed hash catches silent drift on replay.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: MUST be false -- the held-out proxy measures the scored agent's first-win, oracle-distinct from the executable win-check.
